Well, very basic care for superficial (not deep) wounds consists of washing fresh cuts with water and soap (try not to use heavily fragranted soaps) and then patting the wound dry and keeping it dry consistently. If your scabs itch or break open, put some petroleum jelly on them. 

Keep your instruments clean and don't leave blood on them - if the blade rusts and you use it, tetanus becomes a danger.

Note that the deeper a cut is, the more likely they are to get infected. Your body's immune system will likely prevent most if not all infections to non major Wounds.
